rows.grounds: addressed life-forces invoked to enter and remain
indicates the present locus of placement
absolutive expressing arrival prior to remaining
compound denoting the pair of ṭha syllables as locus

items.question: By what invocation are the vital breaths requested to arrive and remain enduringly in the pair of ṭhas?
premises: The vital breaths are directly addressed.
They are requested to arrive at this locus.
They are asked to remain happily for a long time.
items.inference: The vital breaths should be invoked to come here and abide happily and long in the pair of ṭhas.
uncertainties: prāṇā is taken as vocative plural in this imperative context, though nominative plural is formally possible.
ṭhadvayam refers to a pair of ṭha syllables whose precise ritual placement depends on the broader nyāsa context.
items.plain_english: O vital breaths, having come here, may you happily remain for a long time in the pair of ṭhas.
